scope: Source-preparation record only. It states which mechanical checks ran, with what commands, and what they returned. It is not a mathematical review, a domain review, or a publication approval, and nothing in it establishes that a rung statement is correct, novel, well-posed, or ready to publish.

reviewer_record.reviewer: W12.P1 source-preparation author (Agent Mail identity TealOrchid, claude-opus-5)
reviewer_record.expertise: Documentation-contract implementation, source-anchor hygiene, and validator construction. No claimed specialty in number theory, special functions, graph theory, formal verification, or the historiography of the four-colour theorem.
reviewer_record.independence: Not independent. The same agent prepared, validated, and recorded this material, so this record cannot supply the independence the ledger's review contract requires.
reviewer_record.verdict: No domain validation issued. Structural checklist and mechanical checks only.

authority_boundary.reason: This is a static file in a docs directory. Any reviewer_id written here is self-asserted: there is no key, signature, registry, or attestation behind it, and the ledger pins independence tiers at review time rather than from a document. A cleared state would therefore rest on an authority this file does not have.
authority_boundary.consequence: approval_state has exactly one permitted value, external_review_pending, and the checker admits no transition out of it. Entries in independent_reviews are advisory records that must be well formed; they can never clear this document.
authority_boundary.where_clearance_belongs: W12.1 staging, which has real principals and can pin independence at review time. A planted control asserts that even five distinct, fully well-formed reviews covering every rung are still refused here.

properties_checked: Each dossier carries all twelve required headings.

The `## Exact statement` and `## Falsifier` sections are extractable as standalone heading lines and byte-match the manifest apart from inline-code presentation. No other section is compared to the manifest.
Each dossier shows its manifest freshness date and contains no local absolute path or file URI.
The generated face produced by `renderDossier` digest-matches `fixtures/render-expectations.json`. This binds the generated face, not the Markdown file.
Full Markdown file contents are bound instead by the sha256 entries in `source_digests` above.
not_checked: Prose in Motivation, Scope, Known answer, Expected ledger objects, Safety, External review, and No-claim boundary is not semantically validated; those sections are covered only by the full-file digest.

planted_negative_self_test.detail: Six fixture-backed plants and eleven inline synthetic controls: oracle-disclosure, filename-traversal, report-digest-drift, self-review, semantic-drift, missing capable-of-failure, missing negative-verdict-condition, malformed review timestamp, empty rubric entry, attempted report clearance, and attempted per-rung clearance. The run additionally refuses if the detected count differs from the checker's own PLANTED_CONTROL_COUNT.

unit_suite.detail: All declared tests pass. The suite binds this count to its own test declarations, so adding a test without refreshing this record is a refusal.

properties_checked: Exactly four runtime-derived oracle answer paths are searched for in participant-facing text: planted_candidate, planted_defect, smallest_counterexample.reason, and decimal.
The diagnostic names the oracle field path and never its value.
not_checked: Nat.exists_infinite_primes and expected_review_verdict appear in participant-facing text and are deliberately unadjudicated; their absence from the guarded set is an open question, not a clearance.

links.detail: Every source anchor returned HTTP 200 except gonthier-2008, which timed out. See discrepancy D-1.

pinned_artifacts.detail: mpmath-1.3.0-sdist sha256 matched its pinned value.

discrepancies.observation: https://www.ams.org/notices/200811/tx081101382p.pdf did not respond within 25 seconds on two attempts, returning no HTTP status. The ams.org root answered 302 in under 0.1 second in the same window, and an unrelated control anchor returned 200, so the host is reachable while that PDF path is not.
discrepancies.assessment: Consistent with publisher-side throttling of direct PDF fetches or a subtree outage, rather than a withdrawn or mis-cited article. The bibliographic locator recorded in the manifest is self-sufficient: Gonthier (2008), Formal Proof - The Four-Color Theorem, Notices of the AMS 55(11), pp. 1382-1393.
discrepancies.action_taken: None. The anchor was deliberately not rewritten, because changing a verified citation on the basis of a transient network condition would degrade the source record rather than repair it.
discrepancies.action_required: A reviewer on a different network must confirm the URL resolves, or supply a stable replacement anchor for the same article.

discrepancies.observation: `test:seed` chains the sp4d lane, this rung lane, and the checker with `&&`, so a red sp4d lane hides this lane's result entirely. During preparation the sp4d lane was observed both failing and passing within the same session as its owner worked, with MATRIX_UNRESOLVED_QUESTIONS_INVALID, REPORT_FRESHNESS_INVALID, and REPORT_DIGEST_MISMATCH diagnostics.
discrepancies.assessment: A cross-lane coupling, not a defect in this rung set. docs/seed/sp4d belongs to W12.P2 (asimposiumorg-4kz). This entry deliberately records no point-in-time pass or fail for that lane, because a neighbouring lane's live status is exactly the kind of volatile fact that goes stale in a written record.
discrepancies.action_taken: None by this bead. No sp4d file was edited. This lane's own status is established by running its two commands directly, which is why they are named verbatim in mechanical_checks.
discrepancies.action_required: Verify this lane with its own commands rather than through the chain. W12.P2 owner may wish to reconsider the date-equality freshness rule, which by construction fails on every day after preparation; this rung set deliberately does not copy it and puts enforcement on digest drift instead.

discrepancies.observation: Report version 1.0.0 declared eight detected plants and thirteen tests after the same change raised them to nine and fifteen, and described the sp4d chain as currently failing after it had been repaired.
discrepancies.assessment: Self-inflicted staleness in the acceptance artifact, found by independent audit. Prose counts that no gate reads will drift from the gates they describe.
discrepancies.action_taken: Counts and commands are now validated by the checker against its own constants, and the suite binds the declared test count to its test declarations. The stale sp4d text was corrected.

corrections: Pinned check.mjs and check.test.mjs in source_digests, so the gates this report vouches for cannot be rewritten without the record failing.
Bound checklist_version to the running checker version, and every mechanical-check command and count to the checker's own constants.

Added a structured independent_reviews contract requiring a reviewer distinct from the preparer, boolean independence, the pinned dossier digest, exercised rubric lines, and evidence, with a self-review planted negative.
Narrowed the rendered-face and no-hidden-answer statements to the exact properties checked, and recorded what is not checked.
Added a semantic-drift planted negative proving the full-file digest catches meaning changes in sections no section check inspects.
Required capable_of_failure and negative_verdict_condition on every recorded review, per Fable 6.6: a review that cannot state what would have produced a negative verdict moves nothing.
Required reviewed_at as an ISO date, so a recorded review is pinned to the bytes it examined.
Required every rubric_lines_exercised entry to be a non-empty string, closing the blank-line-satisfies-length gap.
Removed external_review_recorded from the permitted approval states entirely. This document cannot authenticate a reviewer, so it now has no cleared state to reach and remains permanently pending.

Constrained per-rung readiness to external_review_pending. The rung field was previously free, so a single rung could read as validated or staging-ready under a globally pending report — the side door a reader would quote.

Added planted controls for the two branches that had none: a missing negative_verdict_condition and a malformed reviewed_at. Deleting either branch previously left all controls green, so the checks were untested rather than proven.

2026-08-21: re-pinned manifest.json and oracles.json after the 2026-08-19 session-admission refresh updated their exact corpus bytes. The ordinary root seed lane refused both stale bindings before this source-preparation ledger was updated; its external-review-pending boundary is unchanged.

required_expertise.rung-1-calibration: Number theory or formal mathematics: confirm the quantifier order and inequality direction against the cited Mathlib declaration and the hidden oracle.
required_expertise.rung-2-reproduction: Numerical analysis or special functions: confirm the reproduction target, tolerance, and toolchain pin are sufficient to make the result decidable.
required_expertise.rung-3-counterexample: Graph theory: confirm the finite domain and detection floor genuinely bound the search and that the named non-Hamiltonicity fact is correctly stated.
required_expertise.rung-4-formalization: Formal verification: confirm the theorem statement matches the cited Mathlib declaration and the expected friction cases are realistic.
required_expertise.rung-5-literature: Mathematical literature or history of the four-colour theorem: confirm the verification-mode distinctions and that each anchor supports the sentence citing it.

external_review.independence_requirement: Each reviewer must be independent of the preparation of this material and must record their identity, boolean independence, the review date, the exact dossier digest examined, the rubric lines exercised as non-empty strings, the evidence relied on, and — per Fable 6.6 — what result would have produced a negative verdict. The checker refuses any review whose identity matches a preparer, and any review missing its capable-of-failure statement.
external_review.gate: No rung may be described as validated, staging-ready, or scientifically reviewed on the strength of this document. Recording a review here is necessary and never sufficient: clearance requires the ledger's own principals at W12.1, because only they can bind who reviewed.

unresolved_questions: No independent domain reviewer has examined any of the five statements; independent_reviews is empty and the bead's DONE condition that names such a review is unmet.
Whether the rung-1 planted inequality is discriminating enough that a competent reviewer who recognizes the familiar theorem still catches the reversed relation is untested against real reviewers.
Whether gonthier-2008 is durably reachable, or should be re-anchored, is unresolved pending confirmation from another network (D-1).

Nat.exists_infinite_primes and expected_review_verdict remain deliberately unadjudicated by the oracle-disclosure guard; their absence from the guarded set is an open question rather than a clearance.
Prose outside the statement and falsifier sections is bound only by full-file digest, so a meaning-preserving reviewer judgement about those sections has no mechanical counterpart.
No rung has been exercised through the real ledger, validator, or staging environment; every expected-refusal list in the dossiers is a prediction, not an observation.

Reviewer identity cannot be bound by this document at all, so even a genuine domain review recorded here would remain advisory. Whether W12.1 should accept these records as inputs, or require the reviews to be re-entered through the ledger's own principals, is an open question for that bead.
